title: PerformanceEvidenceValidator
responsibility: Requires matching current latency and memory observations for each executable unit, callable and runtime target without granting budget approval.

inputs.name: PerformanceEvidenceValidator.required.units
inputs.description: Registered active candidate units at the selected source revision.

inputs.name: PerformanceEvidenceValidator.required.files
inputs.description: Inspected source files with execution classification; unread or unknown source never earns an exemption.

inputs.name: PerformanceEvidenceValidator.validate.input
inputs.description: Selected units, inspected source, observations, exact commit and runtime profile that must agree.

outputs.name: PerformanceEvidenceValidator.required
outputs.description: Executable active units requiring observations; declarative inspected source and CSS alone are exempt.

outputs.name: PerformanceEvidenceValidator.validate
outputs.description: Missing or incompatible latency/memory requirements by unit, callable and runtime target.
